dedupe_keys.name: green infrastructure baseline inventory calumet region of illinois metropolitan planning council

description: The Green Infrastructure Baseline Inventory, GIBI, is a dataset being developed by the Metropolitan Planning Council with the Calumet Stormwater Collaborative to document existing green infrastructure installations in the Calumet region of Illinois. The stated aim is to inform stormwater management planning by recording where green infrastructure already exists and how it is performing, as a free and publicly accessible resource. The project page invites developers and builders of green stormwater infrastructure to contribute in three ways, including a submission form, and links a map of the Calumet region. Coverage: one region, built up from contributions, so completeness depends on participation. Access: free; the licence, download format and record count are not stated on the page read. Caveats: the inventory was described as in development, and no performance measures are shown on the page. It supports regional stormwater retrofit and capacity planning, and relates to the Seattle green stormwater infrastructure layer in the catalogue.
